name: @ezil-os/local
description: EZiL OS local mode: a native Bun host that drives the desktop container through the `docker` CLI and publishes its ports on 127.0.0.1. Contains NO Cloudflare code and no Cloudflare dependency.

scripts.//doctor: RESERVED — row T5 adds the real `doctor` script here (preflight: docker daemon reachable, image present, ports free). Left as a comment key, not a script, so `bun run doctor` fails loudly as 'not found' until T5 lands rather than silently succeeding as a no-op.
